verdict.rationale: Poly documents Shared Drives, team-owned storage spaces with their own members and roles, plus sharing files or folders with specific people (poly-docs-34, poly-docs-24, poly-docs-33, poly-docs-52). On the collaboration side, parallel edits are kept as conflict revisions that can be opened or restored, so nobody's changes are lost (poly-docs-50, poly-docs-10). However, nothing shows real-time co-editing or automatic merging: concurrent edits become separate revisions that users must reconcile by hand. File sharing is also described mainly in terms of letting others "see" content. Missing for 10: real-time collaborative editing or merge of concurrent changes, explicit edit-permission semantics for shared files, independent or hands-on corroboration.
